title: Leek, Broad Bean and Dorblu Quiche
subtitle: with a light royale filling
description: A buttery tart shell filled with leeks, broad beans and grated dorblu cheese, covered with an airy cream, milk and egg royale and baked until golden.

steps.text: Make the pastry: process the cold sifted flour, cold diced butter and 1 teaspoon of salt in a food processor to fine crumbs. Add 1 egg and process only until a uniform dough forms (add a little iced water if needed). Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 170°C. Roll the pastry on a floured surface to a circle 0.25 to 0.5 cm thick, gently turning and flouring as you go.
Transfer to a greased 26 cm pie tin and press firmly into the sides. Prick with a fork in several places, cover with baking paper and fill with dry chickpeas or beans.
Bake for 15 minutes, remove the paper and weights and cool for about 10 minutes. Leave the oven on.

Melt 1 tbsp butter with the olive oil in a wide pan and fry the leeks (white part only, cut into 1 cm rings) and finely chopped thyme for 3 minutes over medium-high heat until translucent. Add 2 tbsp water and cook for 5 minutes over low heat until the leek is cooked. Season with salt and drain in a sieve.
Mix the leek with the broad beans, spread evenly over the pastry and scatter over the cheese.

Make the royale: blend the milk, cream, 5 eggs, nutmeg and a little salt (careful with the salt) in a food processor for about 2 minutes until frothy and very airy. Pour into the tart shell until the filling is covered by 2 cm.
Return to the oven and bake for 30 minutes until nicely golden. Cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.
